items: A run of base units with a stone worktop. len is the length along the wall.
A free-standing island with a worktop; put it a metre and a half off the counter run.
An overhead cupboard. Hang it 1.5 m above the floor of its storey.
A base unit with a recessed basin and a tap, worktop height.
A freestanding cooker: oven below, four rings on the hob.
A tall fridge-freezer; usually at the end of the counter run.
A 60 cm machine that slots under the worktop, next to the sink.
Pan, seat and cistern; the cistern is at the back, so the piece faces -z (north).
A 1.7 m tub: l runs along the wall, w is the depth into the room.
A tray with two glass screens on the open sides and a riser with a head.
A pedestal basin with a tap.
A flat mirror; hang it 1.2 m above the floor, over the basin.
A wall rail; hang it about 1.3 m above the floor.
A 60 cm front-loader for the utility room or under the worktop.
A cylindrical hot-water boiler; hang it 0.8 m up or stand it on the floor.
